about: Hand-kept triage of the keyword sentences of the pinned ACDC specification text, read by scripts/clause-coverage. Each entry is keyed by the exact text of one keyword sentence as docs/coverage/acdc.md shows it. When that text occurs more than once in a pinned text, the entry is a list of judgments, each with section (the heading it is under, as the report shows it) and, when the text also repeats within that section, occurrence (1-based, in text order); a judgment must identify exactly one sentence or it is refused. Fields: scope, one of validator (a validator, verifier or parser can be tested on it through an adapter with fixed inputs), out-of-scope (it binds a role no adapter plays, such as an issuer acting outside the bundle a validator is given) or untestable (no case could test it; reason is then required and says why); security, true when getting it wrong lets an attacker forge or misattribute a credential, bypass revocation or chaining, or smuggle data; note, optional. A sentence with no judgment is reported as unassessed.
